placements.why: The content describes a mandated organizational onboarding process — a checklist with specific requirements set by an Ops Lead — which calls for an organizational/operational strata category that nothing existing covers.
placements.title: Organizational process and operational standards
placements.frame: What organizational processes, mandates, and operational decisions shape how work is structured and performed?

placements.title: From wiki page to mandated checklist
placements.frame: How does an onboarding standard get established as a mandate, and what does it require of new hires?
placements.why: src-3 asserts the universal onboarding mandate — every new hire completes the Pallasine checklist (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift) in their first week — and src-4 supplies its provenance: it replaced the old wiki page last quarter. Together they name a thematic subject (how a standardized onboarding process is set and what it entails) that future envelopes about onboarding changes or process evolution would continue to feed. The grain test passes: this is true beyond the specific words — it is about the establishment of an operational standard, not merely a one-time event.
